run_after_21-cua-spaces.sh.tmpl.reason: Official cua.ai installer and the only install method cua offers. Mitigated: the gate runs it with --dry-run FIRST and only proceeds to --yes if the dry-run succeeds (per cua-spaces-integration.md). cua publishes no upstream checksum; the dry-run is the mitigation. Gated behind the #101 Cua Spaces provisioning gate (RAM/OS/consent).

executable_post-nginx.sh.reason: Downloads the NGINX Amplify agent install.sh from the master branch and executes it with no checksum/pin. Real supply-chain gap, but LOW exposure: only runs when the NGINX_AMPLIFY_API_KEY secret exists (almost never). HARDEN when the nginx server role is built out: pin to a release tag/commit (not master) + verify a published checksum, or install via the official apt/yum repo. Tracked here so it is visible, not silently present.
